title: Pure Hieratic
summary: Hieratic cards only, with generic staples. Hieratic is a LIGHT Dragon Rank 6 and Rank 8 Xyz strategy whose Effect Monsters Tribute each other from the hand or field to Special Summon Dragon Normal Monsters from the hand, Deck, or GY.

summary.title: Starters
points: Hieratic Seal of Convocation adds any Hieratic monster from the Deck to the hand with no once-per-turn restriction.

Hieratic Dragon of Su and Hieratic Dragon of Nebthet Special Summon themselves from the hand by Tributing a Hieratic monster, triggering the Tributed Hieratic to Special Summon a Dragon Normal Monster from the hand, Deck, or GY.
Hieratic Dragon of Tefnuit Special Summons itself from the hand when only your opponent controls a monster, and Hieratic Dragon of Eset can be Normal Summoned without Tributing.

summary.title: Opening: Eset or Tefnuit + Su or Nebthet
steps: Normal Summon Hieratic Dragon of Eset without Tributing (or Special Summon Tefnuit going second), then Tribute it to Special Summon Hieratic Dragon of Su from the hand.

The Tributed Eset Special Summons Hieratic Seal of the Dragon King (Level 6 Gemini treated as a Normal Monster) from the Deck or GY, or Hieratic Seal of the Sun Dragon Overlord (Level 8) if you use Eset's Level-matching effect first.

Overlay your two Level 6 Dragons into Hieratic Dragon King of Atum, which detaches 1 material to Special Summon another Hieratic from the Deck, or link two Dragons into Hieratic Seal of the Heavenly Spheres.

summary.title: Normal Monster Engine
summary.text: Every main Hieratic Effect Monster (Tefnuit, Eset, Nebthet, Su, and Gebeb) Special Summons a Dragon Normal Monster from the hand, Deck, or GY with 0 ATK/DEF when Tributed. In this pure build, those targets are Level 8 Hieratic Seal of the Sun Dragon Overlord for Rank 8 plays and Level 6 Hieratic Seal of the Dragon King for Rank 6 plays. Once Normal Summoned again on the field, Dragon King can Tribute itself to Special Summon any Hieratic monster from the hand, Deck, or GY.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: Hieratic Seal of the Heavenly Spheres Tributes a monster from your hand or field during the opponent's turn to bounce any face-up card on the field, and Special Summons any Dragon from the hand or Deck when Tributed.

Hieratic Sky Dragon Overlord of Heliopolis detaches 1 material to negate and destroy any Spell, Trap, or effect that targets a card on your field, while Hieratic Sun Dragon Overlord of Heliopolis Tributes any number of monsters from your hand or field to destroy that many cards on the field.
Hieratic Dragon of Su Tributes a Hieratic from the hand or field to destroy an opponent's Spell/Trap, and Hieratic Dragon of Nebthet Tributes one to destroy an opponent's monster.

summary.title: Spells
points: Hieratic Seal of Creation targets a Dragon Xyz Monster you control to Special Summon a Hieratic Xyz Monster with a different original name over it, or banishes itself from the GY to revive a Hieratic monster in Defense Position.
Hieratic Seal of Supremacy Special Summons a Hieratic monster from your hand to start Tribute chains without using your Normal Summon.
